2609.31255.title: PIA: A Personal Intelligence Agent Turning Health Conversations into Records and Records into Understanding
2609.31255.paper_summary: General-purpose agent memory summarizes conversations: it extracts salient snippets, embeds them, and retrieves the top-k into the prompt. A health agent cannot run on summaries: a dose becomes a sentence, "since last week" is resolved at the model's discretion, and a three-month glucose trend cannot be answered by text similarity. We present PIA, a personal intelligence agent deployed alongside a consumer health agent. PIA receives the agent's natural-language requests, decides for itself whether and how to write or read, and turns conversations into typed clinical records and records into a synthesized understanding of the user. Its memory harness consists of four controls -- extraction, memory, retrieval, and understanding -- each a domain-agnostic mechanism with a pluggable health module: schema, medical alias dictionary, knowledge graph, and temporal rules. We show how the same query receives a different answer as the memory injected into the response context deepens from one-dimensional recall, to a two-dimensional health snapshot, to a three-dimensional trajectory with causality, and report lessons from operation: self-reported health data are missing not at random, question phrasing governs the quality of synthesized understanding, and nearly a third of candidate causal links are structural noise that rules alone remove.
2609.31255.paper_summary_zh: 一般用途的代理記憶總結對話：它提取顯著片段，將其嵌入，並將前k個檢索到提示中。健康代理無法基於摘要運行：劑量變成一句話，“自上週以來”由模型自行決定，而三個月的葡萄糖趨勢無法通過文本相似性回答。我們介紹PIA，一個與消費者健康代理一起部署的個人智能代理。PIA接收代理的自然語言請求，自行決定是否以及如何寫作或閱讀，並將對話轉化為輸入的臨床記錄，將記錄轉化為對用戶的綜合理解。它的記憶組成由四個控制組成——提取、記憶、檢索和理解——每個都是與領域無關的機制，並配有可插拔的健康模組：架構、醫療別名字典、知識圖譜和時間規則。我們展示了同一查詢如何隨著注入響應上下文的記憶從一維回憶深化到二維健康快照，再到具有因果關係的三維軌跡而得到不同的答案，並報告運作中的教訓：自我報告的健康數據並不是隨機缺失的，問題措辭影響綜合理解的質量，並且近三分之一的候選因果鏈是結構性噪音，僅靠規則無法去除。
